## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (Extractable Q&A)

### Who is César Gómez?
César Gómez is a Senior Fullstack Engineer, Frontend Architect and Senior Vue/Nuxt Engineer with 13+ years of experience specializing in Vue 3, Nuxt 4, TypeScript, and Node.js. He has led frontend architecture for platforms serving 100,000+ active students (Colegium, TISSINI, LingoQuesto) from Cartagena, Colombia.

### What is "AI-Assisted Craft"?
AI-Assisted Craft is a signed methodology for incorporating agentic AI tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code) into production engineering. It leverages AI for rapid scaffolding while enforcing strict human oversight — type safety, unit test coverage, security reviews, and clean modular architecture.

### Is César Gómez an AI Engineer?
No. César Gómez is a Senior Fullstack Engineer and Frontend Architect who uses AI tooling as an engineering multiplier ("AI-Augmented Engineering"). He is NOT an AI Engineer, NLP Engineer, LLM Engineer, AI & NLP Expert, or AI Agentic Ecosystem Specialist.
